page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at top with page number at left; title in capitals with a subtitle line below; a woodcut emblem in the centre; a four-line verse in italic below the woodcut; a catchword "Qui" at the lower right.

l.i: Regis ad ingenium seruorum turba paratur,
Aurum cor radunt si sit auarus homo:
Detestanda fames auri, quæ non nisi tandem

page.notes: The woodcut shows a man seated under a suspended globe (a bowl-shaped object) with a sword above, a pair of shears at upper left and a comb at upper right, a landscape with a castle at right; it is an engraving and is not transcribed. The title line "BONVS PASTOR TONDET" is set in large italic capitals; "pecus." is a smaller italic subtitle line. The catchword "Qui" is printed at the lower right.
